scope: One additional rank-1 registered trig-output/coordinate cycle before rotation multiplication.
description: Add ROM_OUTPUT between phase capture and ROTATE_MUL. Register all four delayed coordinates and both trig values together; preserve the pair/rank/address/valid lifetime through both wait cycles, multiplication, addition and two writes. Only rotated pairs take the extra cycle (+32 cycles/token). Independently check all six delayed words and reset at the new stage while retaining earlier phase/product/state reset checks. No arithmetic operation or recurrence schedule changes. The initial second path selected trig_c into a sine-product endpoint and had no path; that rejected extraction is retained. The corrected selectors include the captured trig/coordinate inputs of rot_kxs and the ROM-to-capture bank.
